name: MBBS Abroad
scope: Distinct medical-study pathway separate from ANU's nine-country general study-abroad list.
student_profile: Students comparing NMC-compliant foreign medical programs
core_counselling_points: Verify university recognition, medium of instruction, clinical exposure, internship rules and licensing pathway.
For Indian students, check current NMC/FMGL regulations before finalizing admission.
Confirm total cost including tuition, hostel, food, insurance, visa, travel, local registration and exam costs.
Do not promise medical licensure outcomes; licensing depends on current regulations and student performance.

visa_model.note: Visa fees and processes vary by MBBS destination country and university. Build country-specific MBBS visa subfiles when ANU source material is available.

recommended_knowledge_to_add_next: Country-wise MBBS eligibility and NEET requirement
Visa fee and process per MBBS country
